name: @tac
description: TAC Express private registry — TAC-compliant primitives + composed components. Every entry has passed the Fourteen Laws gate (zero-radius, semantic tokens, paper-mono fonts, brutalist offset shadows). Use `npx shadcn@4.7.0 add @tac/<name>` to install a TAC-compliant primitive in one command — no post-processing required.

items.name: button
items.title: TAC Button
items.description: Button primitive with brutalist offset shadow, premium focus bloom, lift-on-hover, and the TAC-specific `glow` variant. Replaces the bare shadcn 4.7.0 Button.

items.name: input
items.title: TAC Input
items.description: Input primitive at TAC's h-9 text-sm rhythm with tac-focus-premium ring. Override of the shadcn 4.7.0 base which uses h-8 text-xs.

items.name: label
items.title: TAC Label
items.description: Label primitive (Radix). TAC-tuned for the form-field rhythm.

items.name: textarea
items.title: TAC Textarea
items.description: Textarea at TAC's form-field rhythm with token-only colors and tac-focus-premium ring.

items.name: badge
items.title: TAC Badge
items.description: Badge primitive with the TAC status palette (ok/warn/err/info/violet) layered over shadcn's default/secondary/destructive set. Used by OpsBadge.

items.name: separator
items.title: TAC Separator
items.description: Radix Separator with the paper-line / sidebar-border token defaults.

items.name: card
items.title: TAC Card
items.description: Card primitive at zero-radius with semantic tokens. For Paper Ops Console card usage prefer OpsCard (composed/ops-console/ops-card.tsx) which adds the corner-tick + accent variants.

items.name: select
items.title: TAC Select
items.description: Radix Select with paper-scope portal content. Verified portal scope inheritance in .ops-console.

items.name: dialog
items.title: TAC Dialog
items.description: Radix Dialog with paper-scope portal content and overlay token.

items.name: sheet
items.title: TAC Sheet
items.description: Slide-out drawer using Radix Dialog with side variants. Paper-scope content.

items.name: popover
items.title: TAC Popover
items.description: Radix Popover with suppressHydrationWarning on the Trigger (Radix useId React 19 / Next 16 workaround) plus paper-scope content.

items.name: table
items.title: TAC Table
items.description: Zero-radius table with paper-line hairlines and density tokens. For Paper Ops Console tables prefer OpsTable (composed/ops-console/ops-table.tsx).

items.name: calendar
items.title: TAC Calendar
items.description: react-day-picker calendar with the nav-z-index + months-relative DayPicker-layout fix that ships with TAC.
